prompt:
Portrait 9:16 cinematic dimensional storybook-animation, luxury outdoor mountain-to-beach wedding. Preserve adult Indian faces, medium-brown skin and natural proportions. DRAMATIC LIGHT: diagonal volumetric sunshafts through waterfall or sea mist, deep sculpted shade, bright fabric rim light, moving caustic reflections; at night cyan moonbeams balance amber practical pools. Modern coastal typography: elegant editorial serif with restrained handwritten accents, pearl-white headlines, deep ocean-teal body copy, brushed-platinum edges, fine cyan glow; no ornate antique lettering. Distinct natural locations, expensive site-specific decor. Cars are parked, wheels fixed; everyone has planted feet. Only camera, environment and subtle gestures move. Tiny mist beads, windborne grass seeds or coastal bubbles hang at varied depths, never a confetti storm. Text-only image, no watermark or extra words.

Adult Indian bride, visibly polished storybook 3D animation, warm medium-brown skin, graceful oval face, large dark-brown almond eyes, gently arched black eyebrows, small red bindi, warm reserved smile. Center-parted dark hair in a low bun, small gold jhumka earrings, fine gold necklace and red-and-gold bangles. Natural adult proportions. Preserve her face, skin tone, age and body in every scene. A teal windbreaker over a cream top, maroon ankle-length skirt and tan walking shoes. Hair tied securely; no bridal headdress during the mountain trip.

SCENE COMPOSITION:
A different high-altitude photo spot well above the pullout. The bride stands full-length in the LEFT third on a safe grassy shoulder, about 62 percent of frame height. She holds a compact unmarked camera near her waist and turns over her shoulder toward the valley, smiling softly as her cream scarf lifts in the wind. A single wind-shaped tree sits off-axis in the distance; layered blue ridges and broad sky occupy the rest. No car in the foreground and no repeated roadside portrait pose. On the RIGHT floats pearl-white editorial lettering: 'Srmt.' in small type above 'Supriya' in large flowing strokes, fine bevels, soft halo, crisp counters. Sunlight lights her face and the jacket edge against distant shade. The winding road is visible far below, then curls toward a broad grassy valley viewpoint down-slope on the right. Keep this exact approved pose, clothes and framing. Backlit pale grass seeds hang across three depths; diagonal sunrays trace her scarf and hair. Keep the high viewpoint expansive and unmistakably outdoors.
